rules.title: Tenant screening fee cap, receipts and refunds
rules.requirement: A landlord may charge a screening fee only up to the yearly maximum and only if a unit is actually available. You get a copy of your credit report, a receipt with itemized costs, and a refund of any unused part of the fee.
rules.requirement_es: El arrendador puede cobrar una tarifa de evaluación solo hasta el máximo anual y solo si hay una unidad disponible. Usted recibe una copia de su informe de crédito, un recibo con los costos detallados y el reembolso de cualquier parte no usada de la tarifa.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to tenant screening fees charged to prospective tenants for rental units in California (as restated by the Berkeley Rent Board).
rules.quote: The landlord cannot charge a prospective tenant a screening fee if no rental unit is actually available.

rules.title: Tenant screening fee rights statement required
rules.requirement: If a Berkeley landlord charges a screening or application fee, they must give you, before taking the fee, a written statement of your screening fee rights and the maximum fee allowed by state law.
rules.requirement_es: Si un arrendador en Berkeley cobra una tarifa de evaluación o de solicitud, debe darle, antes de recibir la tarifa, una declaración escrita de sus derechos sobre la tarifa de evaluación y el monto máximo permitido por la ley estatal.
rules.coverage_text: Owners or agents in Berkeley who charge a fee to purchase a consumer credit report and process a rental application.
rules.quote: When an owner or the owner’s agent gets a request to rent residential property in Berkeley from an applicant and the owner charges a fee to purchase a consumer credit report and to validate, review, or otherwise process an application, the owner must provide, either in the rental application or in a separate disclosure before receiving the fee, a clear and conspicuous tenant screening fee rights statement and a statement of the maximum fee cap permitted under

rules.title: No non-refundable fees to renew a tenancy or change roommates
rules.requirement: A Berkeley landlord cannot charge a current tenant a non-refundable fee to renew a tenancy, including fees when a roommate leaves or when you ask to add or replace a roommate.
rules.requirement_es: Un arrendador en Berkeley no puede cobrar a un inquilino actual una tarifa no reembolsable para renovar el arrendamiento, incluidas las tarifas cuando un compañero de casa se va o cuando usted pide agregar o reemplazar a un compañero.
rules.coverage_text: Existing tenants of residential rental property in Berkeley; applies regardless of contrary lease language.
rules.quote: An owner of residential rental property (or the owner’s agent) cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part, including any fee associated with the departure of a roommate or to request to add or replace a roommate in a pre-existing household.
